scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: Meera receives a pretend notice: the club will be deleted in five minutes unless she sends a code. It also says not to tell the teacher. Kabir notices that the message tries to remove both time for thinking and access to help.
scenes.speech: Meera receives a pretend notice: the club will be deleted in five minutes unless she sends a code. It also says not to tell the teacher. Kabir notices that the message tries to remove both time for thinking and access to help.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: Urgency can make a demand feel more important than its evidence. A threat is a claim to check, not proof of authority. A genuine-looking school name does not turn a secret code request into a safe instruction or require a child to manage the issue alone.
scenes.speech: Urgency can make a demand feel more important than its evidence. A threat is a claim to check, not proof of authority. A genuine-looking school name does not turn a secret code request into a safe instruction or require a child to manage the issue alone.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The team practises stopping before the countdown controls the decision. They keep the fictional notice and ask the teacher through the existing school channel. They do not use the number or link supplied by the alarming message as the only way to confirm its own story.
scenes.speech: The team practises stopping before the countdown controls the decision. They keep the fictional notice and ask the teacher through the existing school channel. They do not use the number or link supplied by the alarming message as the only way to confirm its own story.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The message threatens deletion and says not to tell the teacher. There is no confirmation through the known school channel. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The message threatens deletion and says not to tell the teacher. There is no confirmation through the known school channel. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: Does the countdown prove the notice is genuine?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: No. Pause and ask the teacher through the known channel. A countdown and secrecy demand increase pressure but do not supply evidence of authority.
scenes.speech: No. Pause and ask the teacher through the known channel. A countdown and secrecy demand increase pressure but do not supply evidence of authority.
scenes.dialogue: Distinguish pressure from evidence of a genuine claim.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through urgency and threats, then secrecy pressure, then independent checking. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
